description: Exam analytics summary sent from the Exam Management analytics view to an administrator: attempt counts, score spread, pass rate and per-question difficulty.
subject: Exam Analytics Report: $exam_title
body:

Exam: $exam_title

Question analysis
$question_analysis

A low 'Correct%' on a question usually means it was too hard, ambiguous, or taught unclearly — worth reviewing before the paper is reused.

Kind regards,
University Examination Office
